name: DALT
summary: Psychedelic drug of the tryptamine class.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: The receptor interactions of DALT have been studied. The drug produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: Diallyltryptamine (DALT), also known as N,N-diallyltryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative which has been identified as a designer drug.

summaryZh: DALT是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C16H20N2，有衍生物4-AcO-DALT、5-MeO-DALT等被作為狡詐家藥物。
summaryZhHans: DALT是一种色胺衍生物，化学式为C16H20N2，有衍生物4-AcO-DALT、5-MeO-DALT等被作为狡诈家药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of its family can cause anxiety, panic, confusion, nausea, a fast heartbeat and raised blood pressure, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in people who are vulnerable.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同家族的迷幻藥可能造成焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、噁心、心跳加快與血壓升高，並可能在易感者身上誘發持續的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同家族的迷幻药可能造成焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、恶心、心跳加快与血压升高，并可能在易感者身上诱发持续的精神健康问题。

fact.en: Its two allyl groups are three-carbon chains containing a double bond. Allyl groups also appear in garlic, in the compounds that give it its smell, such as allicin.
fact.zh: 它的兩個烯丙基是含雙鍵的三碳鏈。烯丙基也出現在大蒜中，例如帶來蒜味的大蒜素。
fact.zhHans: 它的两个烯丙基是含双键的三碳链。烯丙基也出现在大蒜中，例如带来蒜味的大蒜素。
